limitations: The verdict depends on the broad wording. A claim limited to particular commercial products would require their architecture records.

our_interpretation: It refers to retrieval-augmented generation: retrieving external information and conditioning image synthesis on it.
The plain categorical reading includes functioning published image-generation systems, including research systems. The commercial-product context creates a narrower alternative reading.
So far describes the history through 2024-01-08, with no stated starting date.
Much harder means substantially greater implementation or computational difficulty than text retrieval augmentation. No numerical threshold is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: The relevant image-generation systems had not used retrieval augmentation by publication, and comparative technical evidence establishes substantially greater difficulty for images.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A functioning image-generation system used retrieval augmentation before publication, contradicting the categorical non-use assertion. The difficulty comparison requires separate evidence.

evidence.explanation: Re-Imagen retrieves relevant image-text pairs from an external knowledge base and uses them to generate images. Its reported evaluations establish an implemented system before January 2024, although they do not measure engineering difficulty against text RAG.
